versions.changelog: Full CLI/MCP parity sync: documents events, subscriber imports/notes/bulk tags, transactional template management, email-sends, suppressions, campaign audience/render/unschedule/resend-to-non-openers, recurring scheduling, forms, landing pages, sequence goals/webhooks/enrollments, template localizations, audience syncs, integrations, sender profiles, tracking, Shopify automation settings, SMS, sync rules, notification preferences, and api-keys management.

Add the feedback workflow: agents report unsupported workflows, bugs, and other product feedback via 'sequenzy feedback' (CLI) or submit_feedback (MCP). Includes upstream hardened secret-handling guidance.

Agent-surface parity: campaign lifecycle control (cancel/pause/resume/delete/duplicate), campaign A/B test management, list/tag/segment mutations, manual sequence enrollment, team invites, inbox triage and replies, and outbound webhook management across CLI and MCP.
Add digital product delivery: products list/sync/attach-file/detach-file CLI commands, MCP product tools, and saas.purchase download.url delivery contract
Remove stale unsupported guidance and document current subscriber list import behavior.
Document subscriber list filters, bulk list import, and the 500-email list batch limit.
Rename canonical skill slug to sequenzy-email-marketing.
